candidates.statement: Inventory's redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s), causing inventory 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs admitted; root cause of redis slowness (load, saturation, config) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating inventory 503 -> order ReadTimeout -> gateway checkout 502, matching the alert's ~2s 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Order metrics show 502s on /v1/orders with healthy postgres ready. Deployment record only establishes order v1.0.0 baseline, not causation.
